all.src: Both legs OI >= 1000, one MLeg order, no chasing beyond $0.03.

exits.src: Flatten by 15:30 ET without exception, and in practice within an hour of the release.
Never allow an ITM long leg to reach expiry: auto-exercise buys or sells 100 shares of SPY (about $60k) overnight. Close any long leg whose delta exceeds 0.90 immediately.

unexpressed.text: SPY or QQQ only. Locally computed greeks and implied move required (Alpaca supplies neither at 0DTE).
Enter no earlier than 10 minutes and no later than 2 minutes before the scheduled release. Never enter after the print - the vol is already paid for by then.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: PRICING GATE: the 0DTE straddle's implied move (total debit / spot) must be BELOW the median absolute same-day move for that release type over the last 12 occurrences. If it is at or above, skip the day. This is the only rule that separates the trade from a coin flip with negative carry.
Total debit per unit <= 0.5% of equity ($250 on $50k); at most 1 event trade per day; counts against the 3%-per-day 0DTE budget.
